forge_add: unsigned int forge_add(unsigned int a, unsigned int b) { return a + b; }
forge_udiv: unsigned int forge_udiv(unsigned int a, unsigned int b) { return a / b; }
forge_sdiv: int forge_sdiv(int a, int b) { return a / b; }
forge_branch: unsigned int forge_branch(unsigned int a) { if (a) return forge_add(a, 3); return 4; }
forge_call: unsigned int forge_call(unsigned int a) { return forge_add(a, 2) + 1; }
